verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several GPUs inside one container, parallel fan-out across many GPUs, and self-serve access without quota requests. None of it documents provisioning a multi-node GPU cluster with a fast interconnect for distributed training. Single-container multi-GPU and embarrassingly parallel fan-out are adjacent capabilities, not interconnected multi-node clusters, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can provision a multi-node GPU cluster with fast interconnect for distributed training without a sales cycle
